voice.name: LaRauque - Hoarse, Deep, and Dramatic
voice.why: Marcel Roux is a weathered dock worker with a French name who has shouted over cranes for thirty years. LaRauque is a hoarse, deep, natural French-accented man: it reads as salt and diesel, not a narrator. Stability 0.5 and style 0.15 keep it from going dramatic, speed 1.0 for a brisk quay.

shipment_count_desc.text: That red crate on the quay weighs too much. Open it and count what is inside.

contract_unknown.text: That contract is not on offer.

contract_not_able.text: You are in no state to take on work.

shipment_sold_desc.text: What was under the canned fish is worth money to the right person. Sell it to a buyer.

greet.text: Harbor office. Mind the crane and mind the ropes. What can I do for you?

first_job.text: Crates, mostly. The coaster unloads onto the quay and somebody has to carry them across to the sheds. It pays by the crate, on the spot.

go.text: Good. Take a crate from the pile by the crane and carry it where the tag says. Then come back for the next one.

crates_offer.text: You, I know. I have a load that must be across before the tide turns. Fast work, better money, and I will want it done on time. Do you want it?

crates_early.text: I keep the big loads for people I know. Come back when the town knows you. Carry a few crates first.

contract_started.text: Good. Crates are on the quay by the crane. Mind the clock, I am watching it.

contract_busy.text: You already have a load on your back. Finish that one first.

contract_cooldown.text: Not now. Let your arms rest. Come back in a little while.

contract_run_open.text: You are carrying something already. Deliver it, then we talk.

shipment_ask.text: That red crate on the pallet weighs eleven kilos over the manifest. I signed for canned fish. Would you count it for me?

shipment_count.text: Open it, count what is in there and come back. If it is only fish, no harm done.

shipment_thanks_report.text: You took it to the desk. Good. The town will sleep better, whatever the dockworkers say.

shipment_thanks_sell.text: I did not ask where it went. I will not ask. Keep your head down on the quay for a few days.

bye.text: Mind the edge of the quay.

replies.ask_work: Is there any work on the quay?
replies.ask_crates: Have you got a bigger load?
replies.ask_crate: Anything odd on the quay today?
replies.count: I will count the crate for you.
replies.reported: I took what was in the crate to the police.
replies.sold: I found a buyer for what was in the crate.
